    "Replaced Pro 1: 'User-friendly interface and ease of use for core features' with 'Intuitive navigation for core marketing and CRM functions' because the user notes showed specific UI clunkiness (list creation) and critical page loading failures (Campaigns listing), but also noted easy location of main areas. The new pro focuses on the positive aspect of navigation despite some UI quirks.",
    "Replaced Con 5: 'Some users find the UI/UX clunky or less intuitive than competitors' with 'Some critical features and advanced functionalities are locked behind higher-tier plans' because the user notes highlighted specific instances of core features (Forms, Landing pages) being unavailable on the free plan, which is a more concrete and Brevo-specific limitation than general UI/UX clunkiness."

pros: Intuitive navigation for core marketing and CRM functions
Robust automation capabilities for email campaigns
Good value for money, especially for essential features
Reliable email delivery and campaign performance
Effective contact management and segmentation tools
cons: Pricing can become expensive as subscriber lists grow or advanced features are needed
Steep learning curve for advanced features and complex automations
Limited customization options for templates and advanced reporting
Reporting and analytics may lack depth for granular insights
Some critical features and advanced functionalities are locked behind higher-tier plans
Integrations with other tools can sometimes be limited or difficult to set up
changed: Replaced Pro 1: 'User-friendly interface and ease of use for core features' with 'Intuitive navigation for core marketing and CRM functions' because the user notes showed specific UI clunkiness (list creation) and critical page loading failures (Campaigns listing), but also noted easy location of main areas. The new pro focuses on the positive aspect of navigation despite some UI quirks.

Replaced Con 5: 'Some users find the UI/UX clunky or less intuitive than competitors' with 'Some critical features and advanced functionalities are locked behind higher-tier plans' because the user notes highlighted specific instances of core features (Forms, Landing pages) being unavailable on the free plan, which is a more concrete and Brevo-specific limitation than general UI/UX clunkiness.
